why_best: It preserves the user's visual line of sight across a dramatic layout change without requiring a distracting full-screen dissolve or slide.
why_bad: Slipping into a slow wipe or spatial push would sluggishly disrupt the precise momentum required when transforming a focal tool into a result display.
trap: Misaligning the shared element's visual center during the instant shift, causing an unpleasant visual jitter that destroys the illusion of continuity.
